lf-dial.description: A control that sets how much of the page shows: Skim shows the headings, the lede and each section's gist, Read the page as written, and Everything also opens every closed detail.
lf-dial.x-instructions: Write it empty with a stable id, after the page's title and lede, on a page long enough that a reader might want only its conclusions. It governs the nearest tab or part containing it, or the whole main. Skim is only as good as the gists: mark each section's conclusion `.gist` (the detail package's author instructions).
lf-dial.x-example:
Why checkout latency doubled

A cache key change on Tuesday sent every checkout to the database.

Cause

The 4.2 release added the currency to the cart cache key, so no cached cart matched.

Hit rate fell from 94% to 3% within a minute of the deploy, and p99 rose from 180 ms to 410 ms.

The key, before and after 
cart:{user}  →  cart:{user}:{currency}

.gist.description: A block that says what its section concludes, readable without the rest of the section; with `lf-dial` at Skim, the headings and gists are all that shows.
